claims.quote: Heterozygous loss-of-function variants in heterogeneous nuclear ribonucleoprotein U (HNRNPU) cause early-onset developmental and epileptic encephalopathy with multiple congenital anomalies.

The patient was a 1-year-old Japanese girl with developmental delay, hypotonia, early-onset epilepsy, respiratory distress, and distinctive facial features, including ptosis, epicanthus, a prominent nasal bridge, a wide nasal floor, a cleft soft palate, and micrognathia.
